rationale: dual_domain_bilateral_n2i-claude-agentic: warm_start=True, pretrain_epochs=1, pretrain_steps=20, n_iter=30, grad_clip=1.0, lr=0.005, proj_n_bf=1, img_n_bf=1, proj_kernel=5, proj_sx=1.0, proj_sy=2.0, proj_sr=0.0005, img_kernel=7, img_sx=1.5, img_sy=1.5, img_sr=0.02, batch_size=1, train_n=200, val_n=214, outer_wall_s=1050, per_scene_s=None, seed=42, rationale=iter-2 (search-20260619-01, corrected 214-slice/321px-FOV metric). ONE KNOB: proj_sr 0.02 -> 0.0005 (projection-domain bilateral range sigma, 40x tighter). PER-IMAGE preserved (warm-start pre-pass + independent per-scan fit on each L277 slice OWN half-angle measurements, GT-free; NEVER amortized). SIX-BOX. (1) iter-1 = SSIM 0.9248 (HIGHEST raw SSIM of any Mayo inference solver) but headroom=0.0 -- below the LD-FBP baseline on the calibrated RMSE-sensitive metric; elapsed 940.4s = 15.67 min; per-scan 940.4/214 = 4.39 s/scene at n_iter=30 (~0.131 s/(iter*scene) on the 2304-view FBP adjoint). (2) FAILURE MODE: high SSIM + hr~0 = the projection-domain bilateral OVER-SMOOTHS across attenuation edges (range sigma proj_sr=0.02 too loose for the 2304-view dense Mayo sinogram), washing out fine structure so RMSE rises even as global SSIM stays high -- same signature as dual_domain_bilateral_supervised (raw SSIM 0.919 highest yet hr only 0.028). (3) ONE KNOB justified: campaign-state lever insight (line 145) -- on Mayo (2304-view) the IMAGE-domain sigma is INERT and proj_sr-DOWN is the documented over-smoothing lever; tightening the projection range kernel preserves attenuation edges -> lower RMSE -> lift hr off the floor. Step 0.02->0.0005 matches the established breast sibling step (breast iter-08 proj_sr 0.02->0.0005). proj_sr is a sigma INIT, not a compute knob: kernel/n_iter/214-scans/FBP-adjoint cost all UNCHANGED, so the 20-min budget is identical to iter-1 (~940s = 15.7 min, ~260s slack inside 1200s) -- zero budget risk. (4) HYPOTHESIS: tightening proj_sr sharpens the projection-domain edge preservation -> RMSE drops -> hr rises above 0. FALSIFIER (NUMBERS): if hr stays ~0 with proj_sr=0.0005, the 6-param bilateral CAPACITY CEILING (not range-sigma tuning) is the limit on dense-view Mayo -- half-view N2I info loss < full-view LD-FBP and no sigma setting recovers it; that retires proj_sr as a lever and the next probe is img_n_bf depth. (5) HARD 20-min budget; val=ALL 214 L277 slices (NOT reduced); PER-IMAGE preserved; in-solver outer_wall_s=1050 (17.5 min) backstop guarantees a recorded result. (6) Do NOT return control mid-campaign.
